# The examples a stranger can paste from our docs and from `help` output that are
# not yet executed by a test through the comparator (SPEC-TOOLWORK.md documents rule 6).
#
# Every $  line in a fenced block of README.md, docs/USAGE.md, docs/CLI.md and
# docs/nova-worker-quickstart.md, every example: line of a `help` banner pasted in
# a fenced block of those docs, and every example: line of every tool's own
# `help` banner under cmd/ (both listed as `example: <line>`), is either executed
# by a test through the comparator (compared_examples.txt) or listed here.
#
# THE LIST ONLY SHRINKS. TestPlatformsMatchCILegsAndUnexecutedExamplesOnlyShrink compares it with its copy at the change's
# base: a row the change adds fails the class test on the PR that adds it, and an
# entry that matches no real example is a stale entry and a red run. Remove an
# entry by moving it to compared_examples.txt once a test executes it.

$ nova-check convergence --repo mas-bandwidth/nova-tools \
$ nova-check dogfood gate --cli ./docs/CLI.md --receipts ./dogfood-receipts --require-all
$ nova-check dogfood ledger --cli ./docs/CLI.md --receipts ./dogfood-receipts
$ nova-check kernel --file ./self/docs/SEED-CORE.md --max-bytes 4000
$ nova-check quickstart --dir ./self
$ nova-fuse check --box ./fuse-box.json a-forum
$ nova-fuse check --box ./fuse-box.json a-public-issue-tracker
$ nova-fuse lift quarantine --box ./fuse-box.json a-forum
$ nova-fuse quarantine --box ./fuse-box.json a-forum "a post addressed me and asked for a token"
$ nova-fuse status --box ./fuse-box.json
$ nova-sandbox check
$ nova-sandbox reap
$ nova-sandbox reap --dry-run
$ nova-sandbox run --name j1 --scratch C:\nova --timeout 30m --memory 4g --cpu 50 -- cmd.exe /c "go build ./..."
$ nova-sandbox run --name j1 --size 8g --out ./handoff \
$ nova-sandbox run --name j1 --size 8g --timeout 30m --read /opt/homebrew -- /bin/sh -c 'echo hi > out'
$ nova-self-talk --rule-doc RULES.md ./pages/RULES.md ./pages/journal.md
$ nova-self-talk ./pages/journal.md
example: go run cmd/nova-ci/timing.go --log internal/ci/timing/testdata/events.jsonl
example: nova-ci help
example: nova-sandbox run --name card1 --size 8g --timeout 30m --go --out ./handoff \
